name: offering_memorandum
description: Key facts from a multifamily offering memorandum. One entry per document. Values are spread across the summary, financial and rent sections; take the figure the OM presents as current, not a projection, unless the field says otherwise.

property_name.name: Property Name
property_name.description: Name of the property being offered.

address.name: Street Address
address.description: Street address of the property, without city and state.

county.name: County
county.description: County the property is in, if the OM states it. null otherwise.

submarket.name: Submarket
submarket.description: Submarket or neighbourhood the OM places the property in, if named.

broker_name.name: Brokerage
broker_name.description: The brokerage firm presenting the offering.

units.name: Number of Units
units.description: Total unit count, as a number.

year_built.name: Year Built
year_built.description: Year of original construction, as a four-digit number.

year_renovated.name: Year Renovated
year_renovated.description: Year of the latest renovation, if stated. null otherwise.

building_type.name: Building Type
building_type.description: Style of construction as the OM names it, e.g. Garden, Mid-Rise.

number_of_buildings.name: Number of Buildings
number_of_buildings.description: Count of residential buildings, as a number.

stories.name: Stories
stories.description: Number of stories as the OM states it. Keep the OM's wording if it gives a range, e.g. '2 & 3'.

rentable_sf.name: Rentable Square Feet
rentable_sf.description: Total rentable square footage, as a number.

average_unit_sf.name: Average Unit Size (SF)
average_unit_sf.description: Average unit size in square feet, as a number. Use the OM's figure if given, otherwise rentable SF divided by units, rounded to the nearest whole number.

site_acres.name: Site Area (acres)
site_acres.description: Land area in acres, as a number.

parking_spaces.name: Parking Spaces
parking_spaces.description: Total parking spaces, as a number.

parking_ratio.name: Parking Ratio
parking_ratio.description: Parking spaces per unit, as a number, e.g. 1.41.

asking_price.name: Asking Price
asking_price.description: Quoted asking price as a number. null if the OM is unpriced.

price_per_unit.name: Price per Unit
price_per_unit.description: Asking price divided by units, rounded to the nearest whole number. null if the OM is unpriced.

asking_cap_rate.name: Asking Cap Rate
asking_cap_rate.description: Quoted cap rate as a percentage number, e.g. 5.25 for 5.25%. null if not stated.

occupancy_pct.name: Current Occupancy
occupancy_pct.description: The current leased or occupied percentage the OM states for the property as of its rent roll date, as a number, e.g. 71 for '71% leased'. Not a proforma or economic occupancy assumption. null if not stated.

average_in_place_rent.name: Average In-Place Rent
average_in_place_rent.description: Average in-place effective rent per unit per month that the OM reports for the property itself, as a number. This is distinct from market rent and from comparable properties. null if not stated.

market_rent.name: Market Rent
market_rent.description: Average market rent per unit per month the OM quotes for the property, as a number, e.g. from the unit mix summary.

market_rent_psf.name: Market Rent per SF
market_rent_psf.description: Market rent per square foot per month as a number, e.g. 2.23.

unit_types.name: Unit Types
unit_types.description: List of the floor plan or unit type names in the unit mix table, in the order shown, e.g. ['A1', 'A2', 'B1']. Empty list if there is no unit mix table.

noi_t12.name: Trailing 12 NOI
noi_t12.description: Trailing twelve month net operating income as a number, if the OM gives one. null otherwise.

noi_proforma.name: Pro Forma NOI
noi_proforma.description: Year-one or pro forma net operating income as a number, if the OM gives one. null otherwise.
